title: geum × intermedium var. willdenowii
intro: Geum × intermedium var. willdenowii, commonly known as Willdenow's Avens, is a hybrid plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This perennial plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation. The health benefits of Willdenow's Avens include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent, providing relief from pain, swelling, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
